messages:
Mira Patel: Heads up — Vanguard Dedicated cutover is scheduled Thu 09:00 PST. Need final slot allocation, autoscale floor/ceiling, and the loadtest plan sign-off.
Ben Cho: On it. Can you confirm the GPU types? I remember they requested A100s but we have a mix in the pool.
Mira Patel: Correct — they requested pure A100. We have 24 A100s in the reserved pool. Goal: steady-state 750 rps with 4x headroom for spikes.
Lina (QA): For loadtests I'll run a 3-stage plan: ramp, soak, spike. Will need the routing policy to shadow prod at 10% and a canary route for 5%.
Samir R.: Autoscale suggestion: min_replicas=2, target_tokens_per_gpu=120k, max_replicas=24. That gives ~18k concurrent tokens if packing similar to bench.
Mira Patel: That sounds reasonable. Also: quota enforcement — Vanguard has burst quota of 1.2M tokens/day. We should validate rate-limiter rules before the cutover.
Ben Cho: I'll lock allocator config. Plan: pin 24 GPUs to the tenant, set allocator_mode=exclusive, and set eviction_policy=graceful. Doing a dry-run tonight to ensure no cross-tenant bleed.
ops-bot: deploy:allocator-config vanguard-reserved -> started by Ben Cho (1769992001)
Ben Cho: Dry-run logs look clean. Key checks: kernel pinned, nvlink up, cuda 12.1. A small issue with one node reporting 94% ECC errors — ops team will patch tomorrow morning.
Lina (QA): Loadtest script ready. Command:
```
rload --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --clients 200 --duration 15m --shadow 10% --canary 5% --prompt-file vanguard-prompts.json
```
Lina (QA): I'll start ramp stage 12h before cutover and soak 2h. Will push results to the runbook page and tag @Mira Patel.
Samir R.: Can we add a fallback model route (quantized variant) in the routing policy? If memory pressure spikes, automatic fallback to q4_0 reduces tokens by ~40%.
Mira Patel: Good call. Add route: primary -> vanguard-3b, fallback -> vanguard-3b-q4. Set auto-fallback threshold at 85% GPU mem.
Ben Cho: Notebook snapshot and heatmap will be attached. Also setting alert: gpu_mem_util > 90% for 3m -> page oncall.
ops-bot: loadtest:stage1 started by Lina (1769993600)
Lina (QA): Stage1 complete. Observations: p95 latency stable, cpu proxy spike during shadowing, small tail in tokenization. Pushing full report to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runs/vanguard-176999
Mira Patel: Thanks — next steps: 1) Ben to finalize allocator and eviction patch 2) Samir to add fallback route & autoscale params 3) Lina to run full spike and soak 4) ops to resolve ECC node before cutover. I'll do a final pre-cutover huddle 1h before launch. :thumbsup:
Samir R.: I'll update routing policy and commit to repo. PR -> infra-routing#482.
Ben Cho: I'll schedule the node maintenance at 02:00 PST and confirm when ECC errors cleared.
Mira Patel: Perfect. If anything blocks, ping me immediately or escalate in #oncall.
ops-bot: reminder: pre-cutover checklist due in 60m (1769994205)
